summary: Nintendo's kart-racing series, covering mainline console and handheld games, arcade collaborations, mobile, mixed-reality, and the Switch 2 open-world entry.

all_releases.reason: skip: original hardware route, but Switch Online is the current official route.

entries.title: Mario Kart: Double Dash!!

emulation.notes: Use increased internal resolution and widescreen only if desired.

entries.title: Mario Kart DS

entries.title: Mario Kart 8
entries.definitive_edition: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe with Booster Course Pass

primary.version: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe with Booster Course Pass
primary.why: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe adds content, proper battle arenas, and the Booster Course Pass with 48 additional courses and 8 characters, making it the complete route for Mario Kart 8.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mario Kart 8 Deluxe on Nintendo Switch or Switch 2 backward compatibility with the Booster Course Pass installed.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Mario Kart 8 release with DLC.
all_releases.reason: skip: superseded by Deluxe and Booster Course Pass for content.

all_releases.fidelity: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe plus Booster Course Pass.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete official version of Mario Kart 8 content.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Deluxe plus Booster Course Pass is the complete route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Wii U original is historically important but lacks the complete Deluxe/DLC package.

entries.title: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe

primary.why: Deluxe is the expanded Switch version of Mario Kart 8, and the Booster Course Pass doubles the course count with 48 additional courses plus 8 characters.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mario Kart 8 Deluxe on Nintendo Switch or Switch 2 backward compatibility with the Booster Course Pass installed.

all_releases.fidelity: Expanded Switch release with Booster Course Pass support.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete official route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Deluxe plus Booster Course Pass is the complete route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Booster Course Pass is paid DLC or included through eligible Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack access.

primary.why: Arcade GP VR is a location-based VR arcade entry and has no home release, so the arcade VR installation is the authentic route.
primary.how_to_play: Play at a supported Mario Kart Arcade GP VR location if available.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official platform.

entries.title: Mario Kart Tour

primary.why: Tour is a mobile Mario Kart for Android and iOS; it no longer receives new content after October 2023 but remains the authentic mobile route while service is live.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mario Kart Tour on supported Android or iOS hardware through the official app.

all_releases.fidelity: Mobile service game with city/tour course structure.
all_releases.reason: primary: only official platform family for Tour.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Mobile service title with no separate platform route.

entries.remaster_caveats: New content ended after October 2023; many Tour courses also appear in Mario Kart 8 Deluxe Booster Course Pass and Mario Kart World.

entries.title: Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit

emulation.notes: Use official RC kart hardware with Switch or Switch 2.

primary.why: Home Circuit requires the physical RC kart and uses a Nintendo Switch or Switch 2 to race through a real room, so the hardware bundle is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit kart set with a Nintendo Switch or Switch 2 and the downloadable software.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official hardware/software route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Requires physical kart hardware; no separate software-only route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Physical kart battery, camera, and course space are required.

entries.title: Mario Kart World

primary.why: World is the Switch 2-exclusive mainline Mario Kart with a connected world structure, 24-player races, Free Roam, and Knockout Tour.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mario Kart World on Nintendo Switch 2 with the latest update installed.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official platform and current-generation Mario Kart route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Ongoing updates may change balance, modes, or content; revisit after major DLC or editions.
